greeting: You're back on Florida ground after the long haul from Dubrovnik, Dan. Two quiet nights to reset before the girls are picked up Tuesday and the Orlando run begins.

needsAttention.title: Two nights before pickup
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20-22 landing-gap lodging is still flagged p1 on your board. You're in St Pete tonight and tomorrow before the Tuesday 3 PM pickup and the drive to the Orlando villa.

needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20-Oct 5 full-size SUV was marked book-outright and is overdue. The note's own warning: don't land jet-lagged on a Sunday and take a walk-up rate.
